ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=2x$ intersects the line $y=kx+b$ at point $P(m, 2)$. What is the solution of the equation $kx+b=2$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the line $y=2x$ intersects with $y=kx+b$ at point $P(1,2)$, \\
therefore, when $x=1$, $y=kx+b=2$, \\
thus, the solution to the equation in terms of $x$, $kx+b=2$, is $x=\boxed{1}$.
